# Footnote recovery controls

Original, manually specified OOXML generated by `tools/footnote_recovery_fixture.py`
using only Python's standard library and our original healthy image recovery
control. All six packages contain a styled heading, two original green PNGs,
a table, a numbered item, a header, two body references on separate pages and
two note bodies. They differ only in numbering properties in `word/settings.xml`.

`continuous.docx` is editable. `eachPage.docx` and `eachSect.docx` require a
read-only preview which retains all content using disclosed continuous note
numbering from 3. Browser comparisons require identical page pixels and geometry
to the continuous control at zoom 1 and .75. This proves recovery fidelity to
the declared approximation, not equivalence with the reference application's restart semantics.

`chicago.docx` and `ordinal.docx` use valid unsupported numbering formats;
`chicago-eachPage.docx` combines format and restart restrictions. All preserve
the full structured document with decimal numbering and separate warnings for
each approximation. Original-file downloads must be byte-identical.

Full restart numbering, section overrides, continuation and custom separators
remain separate support work under ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.11.
